title: Inter Milan Stuns Bayern: Champions League Upset
text:
The Champions League dreams of Bayern Munich were shattered at the San Siro as Inter Milan secured a thrilling quarter-final victory. Relive the dramatic moments and key turning points of this epic clash, which saw Inter Milan advance to the semi-finals of the UEFA champions League. Discover how Inter MilanS tactical prowess and resilience ultimately overcame a persistent Bayern Munich side.
inter Milan Dashes bayern Munich’s Champions League Dreams A Thrilling Encounter at San Siro Sends Inter to the Semifinals
April 16, 2025
Match at a glance Location: San Siro, Milan Key Moments: Harry Kane ‘s opening goal for Bayern (52’) Lautaro Martinez’s equalizer for Inter (58′) Benjamin Pavard’s go-ahead goal for Inter (61′) Eric Dier’s goal for Bayern (76′) Attendance: 71,000 Outcome: Inter advances to the Champions league Semifinals The Dream Lives On Inter Milan’s quest for a historic treble—Serie A, Coppa Italia, and Champions League—remains a distinct possibility. Two years after a 1-0 defeat against Manchester City in the final, Inter finds itself back in the final four of Europe’s premier football competition.
The Nerazzurri have dashed Bayern Munich’s aspirations of participating in the Finale Dahoam (final at home in Bavarians), which was scheduled for May 31 at their Allianz Arena.
Bayern’s Initial Onslaught Bayern Munich, needing to score, started the match aggressively. Michael Olise, the French international, had an early prospect in the 3rd minute, but his shot was deflected by Benjamin Pavard.
Despite numerous attempts, often disorganized, vincent Kompany’s squad struggled to find the net in the first half, which was further complicated by strong winds.
A Dramatic Turn After the Break The second half, played in the rain, saw a complete conversion in the match’s dynamics.
Key Stats Inter had only conceded three goals in twelve Champions League games prior to this match. Harry kane scored his eleventh goal in the competition this season. Harry Kane broke the deadlock in the 52nd minute. The captain of Three Lions took advantage of the too loose marking of Federico Dimarco to surprise Yann Sommer with his eleventh goal in the competition this season.
However,Inter responded swiftly. Lautaro Martinez equalized in the 58th minute from a corner, shifting the advantage to the Italian champions.
Just three minutes later, San Siro erupted as Benjamin Pavard scored Inter’s second goal with a header, again from a corner.
Despite the lead, Inter began to concede ground, and Eric Dier scored in the 76th minute with a header, injecting anxiety into the San Siro crowd.
Bayern pressed until the final whistle, with Kingsley Coman having a late chance in added time, but Inter held firm.
Echoes of 2010 Inter’s upcoming semi-final clash against Barcelona evokes fond memories for the tifosi .
The last time the Inter faced the Catalans in the semi-finals of the C1, in April 2010, only evokes good memories of its tifosi.
Football History Archives
In 2010, en route to their third Champions League title, Inter, then managed by Jose Mourinho, defeated Barcelona 3-1 in the first leg of the semi-final, which featured stars like Lionel Messi and Zlatan Ibrahimovic. Although they lost 1-0 in the return leg at Camp Nou, inter secured their place in the final.
